visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a mustache, wearing a gray knitted sweater and blue jeans, stands next to a woman in a white long-sleeved crop top and denim jeans. They are in a brightly lit studio with white walls, framed artwork, and green plants in the background. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the woman's midriff. The man points his index finger at her navel area. Circular graphic overlays showing fatty bellies appear with red 'X' marks. (3) The scene shifts back to a medium shot. The man gestures enthusiastically with his hands while speaking. A cartoon character, Snorlax, appears on screen with a red 'X' over it. (4) The man demonstrates the first acupoint, 'Tianshu', by placing his fingers on either side of the woman's belly button. Red dots mark the locations on her skin. (5) In a series of cuts, the man demonstrates two more acupoints, 'Qihai' and 'Guanyuan', located below the navel. He uses his fingers to measure the distance and presses the spots. (6) A graphic of a purple balloon appears over the woman's stomach and then deflates rapidly. (7) The video concludes with the man looking directly at the camera, clapping his hands together and giving a thumbs up, while text overlays encourage viewers to follow him.

The voice continues at a fast pace, listing types of belly fat with rhythmic emphasis. (3) A cartoonish 'pop' SFX is heard as graphics appear. The BGM remains steady in the background with a consistent tempo. (4) As each acupoint is mentioned, a subtle 'whoosh' or 'click' SFX marks the visual demonstration. The speaker's tone is instructional yet enthusiastic, using dynamic pitch contours to maintain engagement. (5) A bubbly 'deflating' SFX accompanies the balloon graphic. The BGM swells slightly in volume during transitions between phases. (6) The video ends with a celebratory vocal tone and a final rhythmic flourish in the music, concluding with a quick fade-out.
